request: Publish the approved shared guest calendar visual redesign.

deployment.promotion: Public tenant domain verified on this deployment

manifest.scope: Calendar/departure styling, accessible states and compact progress spacing only. No business logic or environment changes.

changes: Quiet seven-column calendar with explicit gaps and aligned weekday labels
One brand-colored selection with check mark, distinct inset keyboard focus, subdued struck unavailable dates and small today dot
Restrained month controls and consistent departure choices
Compact progress spacing prevents the existing 320px overflow

preservation.excluded: Unrelated workspace booking questions, availability, checkout, tenant and admin changes were excluded.

validation.production_build: Next.js 16.3.3 build and TypeScript passed on Vercel
validation.local_source_checks: TypeScript passed; lint had zero errors and eight existing warnings
validation.calendar_states: Available, selected, unavailable, today, hover, keyboard focus and reduced motion passed
validation.behavior: Date selection clears time selection; departure selection, month navigation, deep link, local draft persistence and Continue/Back passed

checks: Kayak calendar reaches guest details and cookie notice clears mobile Continue
Claires retains its own catalog and tenant branding
existing_smoke.writes: Every request other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS was blocked

unrelated_defects.issue: The separately reported session-dependent departure discrepancy
unrelated_defects.status: Outside this visual change; existing production filtering and selection behavior preserved.

unrelated_defects.issue: Existing date-heading mismatch across browser and tenant timezones
unrelated_defects.evidence: An Africa/Johannesburg browser with America/New_York fixture tenant displayed Thu, 01 Oct while calendar selection and departure ID were Friday, 2 October. The existing Date/formatting logic is unchanged from the previous production source.
unrelated_defects.status: Not changed as part of the visual redesign.

limitations: No booking, payment or provider notification submitted; validation stops at guest details and returns to the calendar.
rollout: Scoped calendar deployment only; broader production qualification remains paused.
